questions.question: A park ranger wants to find the distance x, in feet, across a pond. Points A, E, B, C, and D are marked so that segments AC and DE intersect at B, A and E are on opposite sides of the pond, and C and D are on land. Segment AE has length x. The lengths of AB, EB, BD, and CD are 1800 feet, 1400 feet, 700 feet, and 800 feet, respectively. Angle AEB and angle CDB have the same measure. What is the value of x?
questions.explanation: Angles AEB and CDB are equal and the angles at B are vertical angles, so triangles ABE and CBD are similar, with AE corresponding to CD and EB corresponding to DB. Thus x/800 = 1400/700, so x = 1600.
